messages:
Mara: Quick thread — ran the "gentle-failover" admission tweak in canary-3 yesterday. Short summary: p50 across calls dropped ~12% under KV burst test, overall throughput up ~6%, BUT p99 tail increased ~18% when dedicated lanes saturated. Logs + config below, want input on whether we should clamp token budget or route to fallback earlier.

Alex: Nice. Can you paste the exact config you rolled?

Mara: Sure:

```yaml
admission:
  mode: gentle-failover
  token_budget_target: 0.65
  budget_clamp: [0.3, 0.85]
  lane_split:
    dedicated: 0.6
    shared: 0.4
kv:
  prefetch_windows: 2
  kv_fastpath_threshold: 0.85
```

Jin: How are you measuring "dedicated lanes saturated"? Is it GPU utilization or queue depth?

Mara: Using queue depth + kernel_lock_time metrics. When dedicated_util > 78% and ded_queue_len > 24, we saw p99 spikes. Kernel hints showed more kernel switching overhead.

Sam: Could kernel selection thrash cause that? If batches are smaller due to failover, we may pick slower kernels more frequently. :thinking: 

Mara: Exactly. Profiling shows microbatches moved to a fallback kernel with 2-3x context-switch cost. Extract:

```text
t=00:12:33 kernel_switches=37 microbatch_avg_tokens=18 fallback_kernel_ms=9.2 default_kernel_ms=4.1
```

Alex: Suggestion: add hysteresis on kernel selection so we only switch if avg_batch_tokens < 12 for 15s. Also consider increasing token_budget_target for dedicated lane during bursts. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Sam: Another idea: make KV hits reduce budget consumption immediately (fast-path): if kv_hit_rate > 0.9 then effective_token_cost *= 0.35

Mara: Ran a short sim with that: p99 improved back down to +3% vs baseline, p50 still -10%. Sim config attached.

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy "gentle-failover-v2" on canary-3 (id: canary-3) at 2025-11-14T09:42:10Z :rocket:

Jin: OK let's prototype hysteresis + kv fast-path. Who wants to own perf test runs?

Sam: I'll coordinate. I'll run the same KV burst test and add GPU kernel trace.

Mara: Thanks. I'll push a patch for hysteresis and budget clamp. Plan: canary v2 + 24h soak, abort if p99 > 10% over baseline.

Alex: +1. Also add an observer metric for "kernel_switch_rate" and alert if > 20/min.

Mara: Noted. I'll update the runbook and post a quick checklist.

Sam: I'll post test scripts later today.

Mara: I'll post results in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :shipit:
